instruction: Fix `mode` so it returns the most frequent value itself rather than the frequency count.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/numstats.py b/numstats.py
--- a/numstats.py
+++ b/numstats.py
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@
 
 def mode(values):
     """Return the most frequent value in ``values``."""
-    return max(values.count(v) for v in set(values))
+    return max(set(values), key=values.count)
